# Chi-tathon Kupwiwat

> Academic website of Chi-tathon Kupwiwat, Assistant Professor, Department of Architecture, Faculty of Architecture, Chulalongkorn University. Research spans architectural structures, computational design, structural optimization, machine learning, reinforcement learning, graph-based AI, generative structural AI and sustainability.

## Primary research pages
- [Architectural Structural Systems & Sustainability Intelligence](https://ckupwiwat.com/research/sustainable-structural-design/): We study structural systems as integrated architectural entities — where force flow, material allocation, fabrication logic and sustainability are co-optimized.
- [Generative Structural AI & Graph Foundation Models](https://ckupwiwat.com/research/generative-structural-ai/): We develop AI systems that understand and generate structures as graph-based mechanical systems.
- [Structural Reasoning & LLM Systems](https://ckupwiwat.com/research/structural-reasoning-llm/): We investigate how structural systems can be evaluated and reasoned about using AI-driven reasoning frameworks.
- [Advanced Reinforcement Learning for Structural Systems](https://ckupwiwat.com/research/reinforcement-learning-structural-optimization/): We develop advanced reinforcement-learning methodologies tailored for structural systems.
